notes.title: Playtest #2 Ends April 24
notes.notes:
Hello playtesters! We wanted to give you a heads-up that [b]we'll be closing the playtest on Wednesday, April 24, 2024, at 12:00 PM PST[/b] to allow our team to analyze the data we've gathered.

Thank you all so much for participating and for your insightful feedback. We'll be conducting more playtests in the future so hang tight! Since you're in now, you should be in all of the playtests going forward. We're looking forward to showing you additional content!

Make sure to get those high scores on the leaderboards this weekend before the playtest ends!

notes.title: Rift Playtest #2
notes.notes:
Hi folks! We've made a number of small changes to the build based on the feedback we received from the last playtest. As always, we would love your feedback on our changes. Don't forget you can hit CTRL+B to send feedback at any time during gameplay.

Any item noted by Cadence's Guitar 🎸 is something your feedback directly helped us improve or change, so keep it coming!

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[h3]Improved Calibration Experience[/h3]
[list][*] Calibration test should make better corrections to calibration
[*] Calibration process should yield more accurate results[/list]
[h3]New Score Results Screen 🎸[/h3]
[list][*] You can press X to view additional information in the Detailed Breakdown
[*] Most of the screen is placeholder - we would really like your feedback on our planned additions, and would love to know if we've missed anything you want to see![/list]
[h3]Improved Practice Mode 🎸[/h3]
[list][*] Set practice mode to start and end wherever you want
[*] Choose to loop the segment or play just once
[*] Hit ratings in practice mode will list if they're Early or Late inputs[/list]
[h3]Changed Monster Animation Curves and Improvements 🎸[/h3]
[list][*] Monsters move in a much snappier fashion to improve readability
[*] Harpies have a brand new animation to improve readabiilty
[*] Zombie animation curves were changed for the same reason[/list]
[h3]Changed Scoring Mechanics 🎸[/h3]
[list][*] We heard you loud and clear that combo-weighted scoring was not the preferred mechanic
[*] We now provide a bonus based on combo multiplier (max modifier of x4)
[*] [b]Please let us know what you think![/b][/list]
[h3]Changed Vibe Power Mechanics 🎸[/h3]
[list][*] Vibe Power is now accumulated by completing Vibe Chains (there's a new tutorial!)[/list]
[h3]Added Quick Retry 🎸[/h3]
[list][*] You can press R at any time in a Rhythm Rift to quickly restart the level.[/list]
[h3]Removed Modifiers[/h3]
[list][*] Great feedback from last playtest - we're still working on incorporating that feedback! Watch this space ;) [/list]
[h2]Fixes 🎸[/h2]
[list]
[*] Leaderboards now display correctly in relation to your current position
[*] Missing tutorial regarding monsters wrapping around the board has been added
[/list]

notes.title: Rift Playtest #1 Ending on March 4
notes.notes:
Hello playtesters! We wanted to give you a heads-up that [b]we'll be closing the playtest on Monday, March 4, 2024, at 10:00 AM PST[/b] to allow our team to analyze the data we've gathered.

Thank you all so much for participating and for your insightful feedback. This is just the first of several playtests, and since you're in now, you should be in all of them going forward. We're looking forward to showing you additional content!

notes.title: Welcome to the Rift of the NecroDancer Playtest!
notes.notes:
Hello and welcome to the Rift playtest! We're so happy to have you here, and we're looking forward to your feedback.

We plan on doing periodic playtests from now until the game's launch. Since you're here, you should have access to each subsequent playtest! This first playtest is a small slice of the main game mode of the game, which we call Rhythm Rifts, and we plan on adding additional songs/modes as they're ready.

If you have feedback to deliver, we encourage you to hit ctrl+b at any point when you're in the game to open up a feedback form. The feedback goes directly to the devs, and we read all of it!

That said, you're welcome to use the Steam forums to discuss and deliver feedback as well. We'll do our best to monitor them.

We encourage you to write/update your game review with Recommended or Not Recommended as you would with any game you would own.

We hope you have fun!
